title: Uzziah’s Reign and Pride

questions.question: How old was Uzziah when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 26:1 (ESV): "And all the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king..."

questions.question: Who instructed Uzziah in the fear of God?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 26:5 (ESV): "He set himself to seek God in the days of Zechariah, who instructed him in the fear of God..."

questions.question: What happened as long as he sought the LORD?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 26:5 (ESV): "...and as long as he sought the LORD, God made him prosper."

questions.question: What invention did Uzziah have in Jerusalem?
options: Machines offered by skillful men to shoot arrows and great stones
questions.correctAnswer: Machines offered by skillful men to shoot arrows and great stones
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 26:15 (ESV): "In Jerusalem he made machines, invented by skillful men... to shoot arrows and great stones."

questions.question: What led to Uzziah's downfall?
options: He grew proud, to his destruction
He made an alliance with Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: He grew proud, to his destruction
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 26:16 (ESV): "But when he was strong, he grew proud, to his destruction..."

questions.question: What sin did Uzziah commit in the temple?
options: He entered the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense
questions.correctAnswer: He entered the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 26:16 (ESV): "...For he was unfaithful to the LORD his God and entered the temple of the LORD to burn incense..."

questions.question: Who opposed Uzziah in the temple?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 26:17 (ESV): "But Azariah the priest went in after him..."

questions.question: How many priests went in with Azariah?
options: Eighty priests of the LORD who were men of valor
questions.correctAnswer: Eighty priests of the LORD who were men of valor
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 26:17 (ESV): "...with eighty priests of the LORD who were men of valor..."

questions.question: What happened to Uzziah while he was angry with the priests?
options: Leprosy broke out on his forehead
questions.correctAnswer: Leprosy broke out on his forehead
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 26:19 (ESV): "...leprosy broke out on his forehead in the presence of the priests..."

questions.question: How long was Uzziah a leper?
options: Until the day of his death
questions.correctAnswer: Until the day of his death
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 26:21 (ESV): "And King Uzziah was a leper to the day of his death..."

questions.question: Where did Uzziah live as a leper?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 26:21 (ESV): "...and being a leper lived in a separate house, for he was excluded from the house of the LORD."

questions.question: Who was over the king's household governing the people?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 26:21 (ESV): "And Jotham his son was over the king's household, governing the people of the land."

questions.question: Who recorded the acts of Uzziah?
options: Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz
questions.correctAnswer: Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 26:22 (ESV): "Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah... Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz wrote."

questions.question: Where was Uzziah buried?
options: In the burial field that belonged to the kings (but not the tombs)
In the tombs of the kings
questions.correctAnswer: In the burial field that belonged to the kings (but not the tombs)
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 26:23 (ESV): "...and they buried him with his fathers in the burial field that belonged to the kings, for they said, 'He is a leper.'"

key_verse_text: But when he was strong, he grew proud, to his destruction. For he was unfaithful to the LORD his God and entered the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense.
